Method of Attack: Phishing emails sent using compromised accounts on email marketing services to bypass secure email gateways by exploiting allow lists of trusted domains
Attack Vector: Phishing emails sent from compromised email marketing service accounts
Use of legitimate IP ranges and domains from trusted email delivery services
Embedding hyperlinks redirecting to phishing landing pages impersonating Microsoft login pages
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing landing pages impersonating Outlook Web App and Office 365 login pages
Compromised email marketing accounts used to send phishing emails
